title: Config
description:
Root of the user `config.toml` and the project `.mailune.toml`.

Every table rejects unknown keys, so a typo is an error at its line instead of a silently
ignored setting.

accounts.description: Accounts this file names. A later layer that sets `accounts` replaces the list.

Account.description: One mail account. Its credentials live in the keychain under `id`, never here.

id.description: Stable account id, also the keychain entry name.
